title: My First 123 Tracing
developmental_focus: Pre-writing motor practice using numeral shapes as large traceable forms. As with letter tracing, independent correct-stroke numeral writing is typically a 3.5-4+ year skill; at 2-3 this book is meant for hand-over-hand tracing with a caregiver.
safety_notes: Content generated programmatically (code, not AI image generation) for pixel-precise numeral forms -- no AI content-safety review needed for this book.
Intended for hand-over-hand caregiver-assisted tracing at this age, not independent correct-stroke handwriting practice.
One large traceable numeral per page, extra-thick and simplified, with a small solid reference badge in the corner.
